description: Whether the integration status screen offers 'retry' per integration type (hometax ID vs certificate, certificate-gated giro/bank, default-true cardsales/delivery, as-is pg/allra), and the legacy server's single-formula simplification.

inputSchema.side: client (B:91826-91900 as summarised in the spec) | server (legacy isRetryable).
inputSchema.type: IntegrationType: hometax | giro | cardsales | creditcard | bank | allra | speedbank | pg | delivery.
inputSchema.entries: client: integrationStatus[type] entries, e.g. hometax [{authType: 'ID'|'CERTIFICATE', certificate: CertificateStatus|null, lastScrapping: {isRetryable}|null}], bank {isActive, certificate, accounts:[{id, isActive, lastScrapping}]}.

cases.name: client hometax: ID only, no lastScrapping -> true
client hometax: ID only, last result not retryable -> false
client hometax: certificate only, EXPIRED -> false
client hometax: certificate only, INACTIVE -> false
client hometax: certificate only, UNREGISTERED is not checked -> lastScrapping decides
client hometax: ID and certificate both, ID side decides even when the certificate expired
client giro: certificate ACTIVE, no lastScrapping -> true
client bank: inactive accounts are excluded from retry
client bank: certificate INACTIVE -> no account retryable
client delivery: last result not retryable -> false
client pg: value as-is, missing lastScrapping is falsy
client allra: value as-is per scm
server: certificate link with UNREGISTERED certificate -> false
server: ID link ignores certificate state, no result -> true
server: pg link without a result -> true (differs from client)
server: last result marked not retryable -> false

openQuestions: The client does not treat an UNREGISTERED certificate as blocking while the legacy server does; which one is intended is unknown.
For pg and allra the client passes isRetryable through, so a link that never ran shows no retry, unlike cardsales and delivery which default to true.
creditcard and speedbank rules are not in the bundle summary; whether they follow bank (certificate-gated, per item) is unknown.
Which scrape failure codes make isRetryable false (wrong password, locked account, unregistered business) is decided by the scraping vendor and not visible.
When hometax has both ID and certificate links, a broken certificate link still shows retry because only the ID side is consulted.
